This specificity creates genuine community engagement potential. Draft B sacrifices comprehensiveness but gains clarity on what the community can meaningfully respond to. Draft A is more thorough but less focused; Draft B respects the brief's emphasis on 'concrete motivation and question/value the community can respond to' by isolating a single, testable comparison rather than a recap of three anecdotes. Draft A narrows to a single dimension (date calculation accuracy) and frames it as an open question without grounding in the user's actual reported results. This grounds community discussion in the user's actual observations rather than speculation.

A's narrowing to date calculation alone loses the file-packing and infinite-loop findings—key evidence of the merge's impact. B's inclusion of all three tasks and explicit performance contrasts (19,121 vs. 19,486 days; single crossing vs. loop termination) gives readers concrete material to discuss and compare against their own tests.
